resources.string: Cable type by maximum service temperature; selects the block of table N°4.4 of RIC N°04.
A1/A2: conduit in walls; B1/B2: conduit or trays on walls; D1/D2: buried; E/F: free air on ladders or perforated trays. At 70 °C only A1, B1 and E exist.
Sizes of table N°4.4, in mm² with their AWG equivalent.
Corrects capacity with factor ft (table N°4.7). For buried methods it is the soil temperature.
Above 3, factor fn applies (table N°4.6). In three-phase the neutral does not count, nor does the protective conductor.
Current capacity of an insulated copper conductor per RIC N°04: value from table N°4.4 corrected for number of conductors (fn) and ambient temperature (ft), Ic = It × fn × ft.
Sets the reference curve, minimum wire size and minimum circuit rating (RIC N°10 and N°04).
Lighting points or outlets on the circuit. A multiple outlet of up to three sockets counts as one point.
Leave empty to use the RIC N°10 value: 100 W per lighting point and 250 W per outlet.
Sizes a lighting or outlet circuit per RIC N°10: power plus 10 %, next commercial protection rating, maximum points at 90 % of its capacity and a wire size with enough capacity per RIC N°04.
Protections are chosen from usual commercial ratings (6, 10, 16, 20, 25, 32… A). Every lighting circuit has an RCD of at most 30 mA, and one RCD groups at most 3 circuits.
